activities.name: SendMessage
activities.description: Send a request to an intelligence service.

coverage.notes: Mapped core/concrete forward original Plan to local helpers. SendMessage resolves original Config; runtime policy/model profiles are jacket-owned and excluded. HandleMessage reads Plan.Path/Format but message data is ItemSignal-rooted. Finite policy presence checks are not value reads. Other-adapter formatting internals are opaque.

All three mapped activities have concrete branches. SendMessage and SendMessageOriginal call the same Responses helper; HandleMessage resolves ItemSignal content using Plan.Path and optionally calls Format. Shared Config extraction happens before the switch. Helper clone context reads are included; recursive REST/Format inventories are excluded.
